status: Exploratory numerical pilot; criteria and seeds fixed before study execution

fixed_candidates.physical_caps: The commanded fixed allocation is identical across held-out devices; each realised gain is min(commanded gain, that device's physical cap). Initial-frozen retains both the initial gains and b. The recovery-only arm freezes initial gains but lets b learn.
fixed_candidates.selection: Per condition, maximize number of calibration devices passing the unconditioned criteria, then minimize missed plus extra spikes, then failing cells, then mean active-port gain. Evaluate the selected allocation without retuning on the four held-out devices.

parameter_semantics.main_threshold: Independent cell trigger thresholds 1*(1+dispersion*x). The active reset remains q=1; FAST lasts 1 and emissions keep the canonical waveform. This does not test variable pulse amplitude/duration.
parameter_semantics.kappa: Independent cell leak .5*(1+dispersion*x), shared by that cell's main and three auxiliary READY equations. Other vector fields stay unchanged.
parameter_semantics.auxiliary_thresholds: Independent per-port perturbations of the three transition charges (1,.8,.1); rest RM=.025 and actuation factors stay fixed. Full MARK dose is .5*(first-second), full ERROR dose is 8*(third-RM).

outcomes.primary: Every graph-active cell has exactly one spike in every future source window, graph-inactive cells have none, and every adjacent correctly matched interval differs by at most 1e-7. All six future waves count, including the first at 230.
outcomes.secondary: The same criteria after dropping the first future wave as a conditioning pulse; reported separately, never substituted for primary success.
outcomes.counts: Missing and extra spikes across all 216 cells; final-layer counts also reported. Source-window matching is diagnostic; late/ambiguous responses require causal replay.
outcomes.interval_error: Maximum error only over adjacent waves with exactly one response each. Missing pairs are explicitly counted; null means no measurable matched interval.
outcomes.gains: Mean, maximum and sum on the 540 graph-active input ports at t=230; the non-learning allocation is chosen on calibration devices only.
outcomes.work: Simulator's cumulative main+auxiliary+actuation work during the six-wave future horizon; not the E reserve or a fabrication energy measurement.
outcomes.failure_search: For a held-out learning failure in a varied-threshold/leak family, rerun the same draw at half dispersion and at zero added dispersion; these are labeled post-hoc diagnostics.

limitations: Four held-out devices per condition are a pilot, not a population success-rate estimate.
The preset search is a finite candidate set, not optimization over every fixed allocation.
Presets may differ between declared conditions, but are identical across held-out devices within a condition; this gives the fixed baseline prior knowledge of the condition.
The template baseline is fitted offline using two other learned devices, then frozen; it is not online learning on an evaluation device.
No new box proof, fabrication tolerance or noise robustness is asserted.
